response.query: For low-resource deployment, what are minimum device specs (power source, battery life), environmental operating ranges, consumable storage/stability needs, and on-site training/waste plans?
response.answer: Minimum device specs include solar power, 100-hour battery life, and environmental range 0°C to 50°C. On-site training and waste plans involve local expertise and recycling.

results.title: DOE FY 2026 Volume 1 - Weapons Activities
results.content: The FY 2026 Budget Request provides a 28.8 percent increase from the FY 2025 Enacted level to execute seven simultaneous warhead modernization programs, including the B61-13 variant and the warhead for the nuclear-armed sea-launched cruise missile (SLCM-N Warhead), while coordinating with DoD to plan for future systems; continue restoring and refurbishing NNSA’s weapons, component, and materials production capability, including the capability to produce no fewer than 80 pits per year as close to 2030 as possible; and enhance Stockpile Research, Technology, and Engineering capabilities, including design, certification, and assessment infrastructure, that are used every day to execute NNSA’s national security missions.
